summary:
Reviewed the w210 fix round: commit 08013f27, the one the implementer's result lists. Nothing under features/ changed.
Both fix-now findings of review 5 are fixed as answered:
- the raise runs before the merge, so there is no git reset on the shared checkout;
- a failed raise commits nothing from the round: its branch is dropped, its stage directory removed and its log lines taken back (reading C).
No test was removed or weakened. The one setup allowance (billing made a git repository) holds; plan part 4 predicted it.
Checks: ruff, vulture and import-linter clean; size printed nothing.
Scenarios run: r135, r136 and spec-integration @r44, all pass.
No scenario drives a failed raise; I checked that path by reading only.
One new Minor observation: a merge that fails after a successful raise leaves an unrecorded request upstream.
Review 5's observations 3 and 4 are still open.
